overview: This one-page file consists of a “List of Papers” serving as an index to four reports from Dairen and Mukden concerning foreign-exchange controls in the Kwantung Leased Territory. The listed papers cover the application of Japan’s 1933 Foreign Exchange Control Law, a 1935 amendment and related Kwantung ordinances, and further exchange-control legislation issued in 1937 and subsequently translated for the Department of State. The underlying reports and enclosures are not present on this page; one entry directs researchers to a related Manchuria file.

subfiles.title: List of papers on exchange in the Kwantung Leased Territory
subfiles.about: An index identifies four reports and sets of legal translations concerning foreign-exchange controls in the Kwantung Leased Territory.
subfiles.summary: The sheet lists two 1935 submissions from Dairen and Mukden concerning the extension of Japan’s Foreign Exchange Control Law and Kwantung Bureau Ordinance No. 64. It also records a 1937 Dairen report on exchange-control law and a later despatch by Turner enclosing translations of Kwantung Bureau Ordinance No. 12 and Ordinances Nos. 96 and 97. The Mukden entry includes a cross-reference to a related Manchuria decimal file.

interest: The sheet is useful as a compact roadmap to otherwise dispersed reporting on the construction of a foreign-exchange regime in the Japanese-controlled Kwantung Leased Territory. Its references to successive laws, amendments, ordinances, and translations help establish a legislative chronology from 1933 through the late 1930s. The cross-reference to the Manchuria file also reveals how State Department clerks distributed related colonial and financial material across the decimal filing system.
